news.aiSummary: The Vulkan project fixed a CI issue on llvmpipe by enabling dimension‑3 broadcasting in the MUL_MAT operation. Previously, the supports_op check rejected MUL_MAT calls when the source operands differed in the third dimension, even though other matrix multiplication variants already performed that broadcast. The change allows MUL_MAT to broadcast src0 over dim 3, resolving the test failure.
